section.div: Real-time IoT intrusion detection using behavioral fingerprinting — ESP32 + FastAPI + XGBoost + React dashboard. Detects cloned/ghost devices with 100% accuracy. Features a dual-layer blockchain audit trail: local Merkle tree (SHA-256 chain) for fast tamper-proof logging + Hyperledger Fabric for immutable distributed record keeping.
Discord CLI + MCP Server — sync, search, and send Discord messages from your terminal. Built for developers and AI agents.
Interact with Telegram directly from your terminal. A lightweight Go CLI handling complete MTProto auth flows.
